items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: He was playing Back Bay High School with Mary Brunas, Abby Brunas, who was the other bunch of that band in 19... Jules, I guess. No. That was in 1952. We were playing there in 1952. We were playing together again.

ctx.x: What's the name? G-A-R-R-I-G-A. Garriga. Garriga. G-A-R-R-I-G-A. Garriga. I'm not good on these names. But you didn't come back into music until about 1950 and so on. Late years.

Mm-hmm. No, not David was. He was playing Back Bay High School with Mary Brunas, Abby Brunas, who was the other bunch of that band in 19... Jules, I guess. No. That was in 1952. We were playing there in 1952. We were playing together again. The Brunas was.
